batchStrategy.reason: No municipality in this set is pre-classified as requiring Eindhoven/Amsterdam-scale standalone handling. If the first substantive pass reveals an unusually dense housing regime, it will be split out automatically.

qualityRules: Never use an expired Omgevingsplan version when a current permalink/version is available.
Search application documents in the same pass as substantive law.
Do not infer absence of rules from a sparse main-plan text; inspect integrated regulations and municipality-specific policies.
Concepts/drafts/future instruments are retained as explicit watch signals, never presented as current law.
No batch closure before mandatory final sweep leaves zero avoidable generic open ends.
